SIGNALS.name: agim
SIGNALS.summary: Unconfirmed: a report said OpenAI's 6.2 Sol and Astra models might launch Friday. That passed without a launch, though Sol appeared on a Google Cloud quotas page and two hidden OpenAI models showed up in Devin.

SIGNALS.name: Aravind Srinivas
SIGNALS.summary: Perplexity's CEO argues agents will increasingly be used by other agents, with git as a shared record, so that version-controlled traces make a measurable recursive improvement loop possible.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an updated video generation model from DeepMind with better consistency, more creative control, and 30% lower cost.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a model for security research. It says the model powered its Linux kernel research and is being used by teams at Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks and Cisco.

SIGNALS.name: Perplexity
SIGNALS.summary: Perplexity introduced Teammates, agents that take on ongoing jobs using Computer tasks, skills, memory and tools, and can message coworkers in Slack. Available to Max subscribers on the web.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says Images 2.6 is now in ChatGPT and Codex on all tiers, with GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst also available in the API.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says its security researchers built an automated pipeline that, in one run with an upcoming cyber model, validated and patched 948 local privilege escalation bugs in the Linux kernel.
